PM Modi inaugurates Alluri Sita Ram Raju International Airport in Andhra Pradesh

Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Alluri Sita Ram Raju International Airport in Bhogapuram, Andhra Pradesh. The airport was built at a cost of ₹5,640 crore. The event was attended by Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu and other dignitaries. The airport is expected to improve connectivity with international destinations.
